what: the raw bit differences between the CONFIG_STATUS values observed so far

0x46107ffc.state: rung 1, first child of a fresh load

0x46101f8c.state: rung 1, children 2-16 of the same session

0x46106ffd.state: rung 2 after one clean no-op (x16) and Phase 2 after a faulted round (x5144)
0x46106ffd.controls: 0/16 exact; Phase 2 had no exact frame at all

valid_first_read_vs_invalid.note: the only two bits separating a state that read 16/16 from one that read 0/16

valid_first_read_vs_valid_later_reads.note: tracks position in the session, not validity: both states read 16/16

annotation_not_evidence: under the documented 7-series STAT layout bit 0 is CRC_ERROR and bit 12 is GTS_CFG_B. No file in this repository pins that layout; confirm against UG470 before anything rests on it.
already_ruled_out: the probe issues CMD RCRC before every read and the readback stayed broken, so resetting the CRC register from JTAG after the fact does not clear this state
